name: RPG Gakuen
source:
A school founded by a legendary hero 1000 years ago is now on the verge of bankrupcy. Ikumi wonders why the school entrance exam is exploring a dungeon. He didn’t do well at all, but somehow he passed! Something must be wrong since there’s only girls around. It seems that the school will now focus on adventures in love… Ikumi’s hectic hero life has begun!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一所由传说中的勇者在一千年前创办的学校，如今濒临破产。郁美不明白为什么入学考试竟是探索地下城。他表现得非常糟糕，却不知为何还是通过了！周围只有女孩，怎么看都不太对劲。看来学校接下来要把重点放到恋爱冒险上…郁美忙乱的勇者生活就此开始！

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
